| **[MTGO @VERSION@ (.dmg)](https://github.com/@REPOSITORY@/releases/download/v@VERSION@/MTGO-@VERSION@.dmg)** | macOS 13 (Ventura) or later |

## Installation

Open the DMG and drag **MTGO** to **Applications**, then open **MTGO** from there.

If macOS prevents MTGO from opening, go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and scroll to **Security**. Click **Open Anyway** beside MTGO, then **Open** in the confirmation dialog.

MTGO-OSX automatically downloads and installs Wine, .NET Framework and MTGO on first launch. Later launches will also install MTGO updates as needed.

To change your app icon, adjust graphics rendering or choose where to store MTGO user data, open **MTGO → Settings…**. See [Settings and Data](https://github.com/@REPOSITORY@/blob/v@VERSION@/docs/usage.md) for more details.
